raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Balance **every PPO mini-batch** across DP ranks instead of only the whole train batch, and make `actor.shuffle` / `critic.shuffle` orthogonal to DP balancing: if shuffle is enabled, the trainer first shuffles samples into mini-batches, then balances each mini-batch.

Workers split their shard into PPO mini-batches sequentially and synchronize gradients after each one. `_balance_batch` only equalized the per-rank totals of the whole train batch, so individual mini-batches can still be badly imbalanced and every gradient sync waits for the slowest rank. The legacy `keep_minibatch` branch (#3605) aimed at this, but it is never enabled by any caller, uses `ppo_mini_batch_size` without multiplying by `rollout.n`, and its result is undone by the per-partition sort that follows. The v1 trainer accepts `keep_minibatch` but ignores it.

Related: #3605, #3887, #5639, #6025, #8099

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Paste at least one query link here: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+balance+minibatch
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}` (This will be checked by the CI)

### Test

- New CPU unit tests: `tests/utils/test_minibatch_balancing_on_cpu.py`
  - without shuffle, every mini-batch keeps exactly its original samples and each rank's i-th sequential slice comes from mini-batch i;
  - each mini-batch is balanced across ranks;
  - shuffle is seeded/reproducible and keeps mini-batches aligned across ranks;
  - fallback to whole-batch balancing when the mini-batch size does not divide the batch;
  - balancing unit for actor + critic, and the legacy `RayPPOTrainer._balance_batch` end to end;
  - `make_iterator(shuffle_mini_batch_order=True)` keeps mini-batch contents, changes the order per epoch, and is identical for the same seed.
- Existing `tests/test_protocol_on_cpu.py`, `tests/test_protocol_v2_on_cpu.py`, `tests/trainer/ppo/v1/test_trainer_base_on_cpu.py`, `test_v1_async_alignment_on_cpu.py`, `tests/utils/test_seqlen_balancing.py` pass.
- Simulation with the default workload model (`24576·L + L²`), N=512 samples, 4 mini-batches, DP=16, sequence lengths resampled from a real multi-turn agentic run. Metric: `Σ_i max_r W[i][r] / (W_total / DP) - 1`, i.e. extra time spent waiting at the per-mini-batch gradient sync:

  | DP balancing | mean | p90 |
  |---|---|---|
  | whole batch (current) | 42.3% | 48.1% |
  | per mini-batch (this PR) | 0.23% | 0.34% |

- In our internal 4B hybrid-attention RL runs (colocated, CP=4), a similar per-mini-batch balancing cut the ReduceScatter wait in the actor update from ~24 s to ~0.4 s per step on 8 GPUs. GPU e2e numbers on upstream examples are still TODO (this is why the PR is a draft).

### API and Usage Example

No new config. `trainer.balance_batch=True` (default) now balances per mini-batch.

`actor.shuffle` / `critic.shuffle` now mean "randomly assign samples to PPO mini-batches". With `balance_batch`, the trainer applies the shuffle once per step (seeded by `data_loader_seed` and the step); workers no longer shuffle samples, but visit the balanced mini-batches in a new random order every PPO epoch, using the same seed on all DP ranks.

**Behavior change**: with `shuffle=True` and `ppo_epochs > 1`, the mini-batch *composition* is fixed within a step and only the mini-batch *order* changes per epoch. Previously each rank reshuffled its own shard every epoch, which changes composition but also destroys the DP balance and never moves samples across ranks. Random reshuffling and shuffle-once have comparable convergence guarantees for SGD, and randomizing the order per epoch keeps the same samples from always being updated at the most off-policy position. With `balance_batch=False`, or with PrefixGrouper, or in recipes that override `_balance_batch`, workers shuffle exactly as before.

A follow-up for the v1 trainer could re-balance a fresh permutation every epoch, since v1 workers fetch samples from TransferQueue by key and per-epoch layouts would only cost metadata.

### Design & Code Changes

- `verl/utils/seqlen_balancing.py`: add `get_minibatch_balanced_partitions(workload_list, k_partitions, mini_batch_size, shuffle, seed)`. It optionally permutes samples into mini-batches, runs Karmarkar-Karp per mini-batch, and lays out each rank's shard mini-batch by mini-batch, so the i-th sequential mini-batch on every rank comes from the same balanced global mini-batch.
- `verl/trainer/ppo/utils.py`: `get_balance_mini_batch_size` (balancing unit = gcd of the actor and critic global mini-batch sizes, so both are balanced) and `need_minibatch_shuffle`.
- `verl/utils/tensordict_utils.py`: `make_iterator(..., shuffle_mini_batch_order=True)` visits the contiguous mini-batches in a new random order every epoch without changing their contents. `TrainingWorker.train_mini_batch` enables it via `shuffle_mini_batch_order` and then uses the same seed on all DP ranks (instead of `seed + dp_rank`).
- v1 `PPOTrainer._balance_batch`: use the new partitioning; `_update_actor` / `_update_critic` disable the worker-side sample shuffle and request `shuffle_mini_batch_order` when shuffle is enabled.
- Legacy `RayPPOTrainer._balance_batch`: use the new partitioning and mark `batch.meta_info["minibatch_balanced"]`; `_update_actor` / `_update_critic` switch from the sample shuffle to `shuffle_mini_batch_order` only for marked batches. The "smaller micro-batches at both ends" ordering for pipeline parallel now runs inside each rank's share of a mini-batch so mini-batch boundaries are kept. The buggy `keep_minibatch` branch and argument are removed (no callers).
- Config comments and `docs/examples/config.rst` updated for the new `shuffle` semantics.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] Apply [pre-commit checks](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-linting-and-formatting) (ruff check / ruff format).
- [x] Add / Update [the documentation](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/docs).
- [x] Add unit or end-to-end test(s) to [the CI workflow](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/.github/workflows) to cover all the code: `tests/utils/test_minibatch_balancing_on_cpu.py` runs in the CPU unit test job.
- [ ] Once your PR is ready for CI, send a message in [the `ci-request` channel](https://verl-project.slack.com/archives/C091TCESWB1).
- [ ] If your PR is related to the `recipe` submodule, please also update the reference to the submodule commit.

+import random
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from omegaconf import OmegaConf
+
+from verl.trainer.ppo.utils import get_balance_mini_batch_size, need_minibatch_shuffle
+from verl.utils.seqlen_balancing import calculate_workload, get_minibatch_balanced_partitions
+
+
+def _worker_mini_batches(partitions, mini_batch_size):
+    """Mimic workers: each rank slices its shard into mini-batches sequentially, without shuffling."""
+    share = mini_batch_size // len(partitions)
+    num_mini_batches = len(partitions[0]) // share
+    return [[partition[i * share : (i + 1) * share] for partition in partitions] for i in range(num_mini_batches)]
+
+
+def _check_layout(partitions, num_samples, k_partitions):
+    assert len(partitions) == k_partitions
+    assert sorted(i for partition in partitions for i in partition) == list(range(num_samples))
+    assert len({len(partition) for partition in partitions}) == 1
+
+
+def test_keeps_mini_batches_without_shuffle():
+    random.seed(0)
+    num_samples, mini_batch_size, k_partitions = 64, 16, 4
+    workloads = calculate_workload(torch.tensor([random.randint(100, 20000) for _ in range(num_samples)]))
+
+    partitions = get_minibatch_balanced_partitions(workloads, k_partitions, mini_batch_size)
+
+    _check_layout(partitions, num_samples, k_partitions)
+    for i, shares in enumerate(_worker_mini_batches(partitions, mini_batch_size)):
+        members = sorted(j for share in shares for j in share)
+        assert members == list(range(i * mini_batch_size, (i + 1) * mini_batch_size))
+
+
+def test_balances_each_mini_batch():
+    # Rank totals of the whole batch can be balanced while every mini-batch is not; per-mini-batch
+    # balancing gives each rank one heavy and one light sample of every mini-batch.
+    workloads = [10, 10, 1, 1, 20, 20, 2, 2]
+
+    partitions = get_minibatch_balanced_partitions(workloads, k_partitions=2, mini_batch_size=4)
+
+    for shares in _worker_mini_batches(partitions, mini_batch_size=4):
+        sums = [sum(workloads[j] for j in share) for share in shares]
+        assert sums[0] == sums[1]
+
+
+def test_shuffle_is_seeded_and_keeps_mini_batches_aligned():
+    num_samples, mini_batch_size, k_partitions = 48, 12, 3
+    workloads = list(range(1, num_samples + 1))
+
+    partitions = get_minibatch_balanced_partitions(workloads, k_partitions, mini_batch_size, shuffle=True, seed=[42, 7])
+
+    _check_layout(partitions, num_samples, k_partitions)
+    assert partitions == get_minibatch_balanced_partitions(
+        workloads, k_partitions, mini_batch_size, shuffle=True, seed=[42, 7]
+    )
+    assert partitions != get_minibatch_balanced_partitions(
+        workloads, k_partitions, mini_batch_size, shuffle=True, seed=[42, 8]
+    )
+    mini_batches = [sorted(j for share in shares for j in share) for shares in _worker_mini_batches(partitions, 12)]
+    assert all(len(members) == mini_batch_size for members in mini_batches)
+    assert mini_batches != [list(range(i * 12, (i + 1) * 12)) for i in range(4)]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mini_batch_size", [0, 7])
+def test_falls_back_to_whole_batch(mini_batch_size):
+    workloads = list(range(1, 13))
+
+    partitions = get_minibatch_balanced_partitions(workloads, k_partitions=3, mini_batch_size=mini_batch_size)
+
+    _check_layout(partitions, 12, 3)
+
+
+def test_make_iterator_shuffles_mini_batch_order_per_epoch():
+    from tensordict import TensorDict
+
+    from verl.utils import tensordict_utils as tu
+
+    data = TensorDict({"index": torch.arange(16)}, batch_size=[16])
+
+    def visits(seed):
+        iterator = tu.make_iterator(data, mini_batch_size=2, epochs=3, seed=seed, shuffle_mini_batch_order=True)
+        return [mini_batch["index"].tolist() for mini_batch in iterator]
+
+    batches = visits(seed=1)
+    epochs = [batches[i * 8 : (i + 1) * 8] for i in range(3)]
+    contiguous = [[2 * i, 2 * i + 1] for i in range(8)]
+    for epoch in epochs:
+        assert sorted(epoch) == contiguous
+    assert epochs[0] != epochs[1] or epochs[1] != epochs[2]
+    # Every DP rank passes the same seed, so all ranks visit the same global mini-batch at each step.
+    assert visits(seed=1) == batches
+
+
+def _config(actor_mini_batch_size=4, critic_mini_batch_size=6, actor_shuffle=False, critic_shuffle=False):
+    return OmegaConf.create(
+        {
+            "actor_rollout_ref": {
+                "rollout": {"n": 2},
+                "actor": {"ppo_mini_batch_size": actor_mini_batch_size, "shuffle": actor_shuffle},
+            },
+            "critic": {"ppo_mini_batch_size": critic_mini_batch_size, "shuffle": critic_shuffle},
+        }
+    )
+
+
+def test_balance_mini_batch_size():
+    config = _config()
+    assert get_balance_mini_batch_size(config, use_critic=False, update_actor=True) == 8
+    assert get_balance_mini_batch_size(config, use_critic=True, update_actor=False) == 12
+    assert get_balance_mini_batch_size(config, use_critic=True, update_actor=True) == 4
+    assert get_balance_mini_batch_size(config, use_critic=False, update_actor=False) == 0
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("shuffle", [False, True])
+def test_ray_trainer_balance_batch(shuffle):
+    from verl import DataProto
+    from verl.trainer.ppo.ray_trainer import RayPPOTrainer
+
+    random.seed(0)
+    num_samples, k_partitions = 32, 2
+    lengths = [random.randint(10, 100) for _ in range(num_samples)]
+    attention_mask = torch.zeros(num_samples, 128, dtype=torch.long)
+    for i, length in enumerate(lengths):
+        attention_mask[i, :length] = 1
+    batch = DataProto.from_single_dict({"attention_mask": attention_mask, "index": torch.arange(num_samples)})
+
+    trainer = RayPPOTrainer.__new__(RayPPOTrainer)
+    trainer.config = _config(actor_shuffle=shuffle)
+    trainer.config.trainer = {"balance_batch": True, "critic_warmup": 0}
+    trainer.config.actor_rollout_ref.actor.data_loader_seed = 42
+    trainer.use_critic, trainer.global_steps = False, 1
+    trainer.actor_rollout_wg = SimpleNamespace(_dispatch_info={"actor": list(range(k_partitions))})
+    trainer._balance_batch(batch, metrics={})
+
+    assert batch.meta_info["minibatch_balanced"]
+    order = batch.batch["index"].tolist()
+    shards = [order[: num_samples // k_partitions], order[num_samples // k_partitions :]]
+    mini_batches = [sorted(j for share in shares for j in share) for shares in _worker_mini_batches(shards, 8)]
+    if shuffle:
+        assert mini_batches != [list(range(i * 8, (i + 1) * 8)) for i in range(4)]
+    else:
+        assert mini_batches == [list(range(i * 8, (i + 1) * 8)) for i in range(4)]
+
+
+def test_need_minibatch_shuffle():
+    assert not need_minibatch_shuffle(_config(), use_critic=True)
+    assert need_minibatch_shuffle(_config(actor_shuffle=True), use_critic=False)
+    assert need_minibatch_shuffle(_config(critic_shuffle=True), use_critic=True)
+    assert not need_minibatch_shuffle(_config(critic_shuffle=True), use_critic=False)

+def get_balance_mini_batch_size(config: DictConfig, use_critic: bool, update_actor: bool) -> int:
+    """Return the largest global sample count that every PPO mini-batch of this step is a multiple of.
+
+    Every actor and critic mini-batch is a run of consecutive chunks of this size, so balancing each chunk
+    across DP ranks balances all of them. Returns 0 if neither model is updated.
+    """
+    rollout_n = config.actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n
+    mini_batch_size = 0
+    if use_critic:
+        mini_batch_size = math.gcd(mini_batch_size, config.critic.ppo_mini_batch_size * rollout_n)
+    if update_actor:
+        mini_batch_size = math.gcd(mini_batch_size, config.actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_mini_batch_size * rollout_n)
+    return mini_batch_size
+
+
+def need_minibatch_shuffle(config: DictConfig, use_critic: bool) -> bool:
+    """Whether samples should be randomly assigned to PPO mini-batches."""
+    return bool(config.actor_rollout_ref.actor.shuffle or (use_critic and config.critic.shuffle))

+def get_minibatch_balanced_partitions(
+    workload_list: list[int],
+    k_partitions: int,
+    mini_batch_size: int,
+    shuffle: bool = False,
+    seed: int | list[int] | None = None,
+) -> list[list[int]]:
+    """Assign samples to mini-batches, then balance every mini-batch across ``k_partitions`` DP ranks.
+
+    Workers split their shard into mini-batches sequentially and synchronize gradients after each one, so
+    balancing only the per-rank totals of the whole batch still leaves stragglers inside each mini-batch.
+    Here partition ``r`` is the concatenation of rank ``r``'s share of mini-batch 0, 1, ..., so the ``i``-th
+    sequential mini-batch on every rank comes from the same balanced global mini-batch. The consumer must
+    not shuffle samples again.
+
+    Args:
+        workload_list (List[int]): Workload of each sample, e.g. from ``calculate_workload``.
+        k_partitions (int): Number of DP ranks.
+        mini_batch_size (int): Global mini-batch size in samples. Must be divisible by ``k_partitions``.
+            If it does not divide ``len(workload_list)``, the whole batch is balanced as one mini-batch.
+        shuffle (bool): Randomly assign samples to mini-batches before balancing. Otherwise mini-batch ``i``
+            holds samples ``[i * mini_batch_size, (i + 1) * mini_batch_size)``.
+        seed: Seed for the shuffle, anything accepted by ``numpy.random.default_rng``.
+
+    Returns:
+        List[List[int]]: ``k_partitions`` lists of sample indices, each laid out mini-batch by mini-batch.
+    """
+    if isinstance(workload_list, torch.Tensor):
+        workload_list = workload_list.tolist()
+    num_samples = len(workload_list)
+    if mini_batch_size <= 0 or num_samples % mini_batch_size != 0:
+        mini_batch_size = num_samples
+    assert mini_batch_size % k_partitions == 0, f"{mini_batch_size=} is not divisible by {k_partitions=}"
+
+    order = np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(num_samples).tolist() if shuffle else list(range(num_samples))
+    partitions = [[] for _ in range(k_partitions)]
+    for start in range(0, num_samples, mini_batch_size):
+        indices = order[start : start + mini_batch_size]
+        mini_batch_partitions = get_seqlen_balanced_partitions(
+            [workload_list[i] for i in indices], k_partitions=k_partitions, equal_size=True
+        )
+        for rank, partition in enumerate(mini_batch_partitions):
+            partitions[rank].extend(indices[i] for i in partition)
+    return partitions
+
